lessons.lesson: The feature this order builds on, the Grand Puff cold recast, existed only on a local branch in a Codex worktree, three commits ahead of dev with no remote copy. A handoff that depends on unpushed work must name its exact tip and make landing it the first step.

The picture-book branch moved twice during this task (V34 renumbered pages 4 to 23; V35 proposed new captions). Prompts bound only to page numbers go stale, so each opening carries a caption anchor and a rebind step.

A free-text owner answer superseded part of an earlier bounded decision (the Guide voice in ODR-LUNA-OBJECTIVE-GUIDES-20261014). Record the supersession and Claude's reading of the words in the register entry, so the owner can correct the reading.
